# lakekeeper_table_protection (Resource)

The `lakekeeper_table_protection` resource manages the protection flag of one table in Lakekeeper.

Protection prevents Lakekeeper from dropping the table. The table itself is not managed by this resource: create it with an Iceberg or Generic Table client and reference its ID here.

Changing `protected` sets or clears the flag. **Destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state; it does not change the protection flag on the server.** Unprotect the table explicitly with `protected = false` before removing the resource if that is what you want.

Changing `warehouse_id` or `table_id` also only removes the old resource from Terraform state: it does not change the protection flag of the table it referred to, so a protected table stays protected. Add a `lakekeeper_table_protection` block for that table with `protected = false` to unprotect it.

A missing or soft-deleted table cannot be protected: Lakekeeper rejects the request and the provider reports the error instead of silently skipping the change.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/warehouse/operation/set_table_protection)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The table is created outside Terraform; reference its existing UUID.
resource "lakekeeper_table_protection" "orders" {
  warehouse_id = "a4653498-1dd9-4f12-a2e4-1cc7d4023226"
  table_id     = "9ad1e2a0-5df3-4c05-8e5e-7a1f2fe7c2f1"
  protected    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `protected` (Boolean) Whether the table is protected from deletion.
- `table_id` (String) The ID of the table.
- `warehouse_id` (String) The ID of the warehouse that contains the table.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The internal ID of this resource, in the form `{{warehouse_id}}/{{table_id}}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# id is "{{warehouse_id}}/{{table_id}}"
terraform import lakekeeper_table_protection.orders "a4653498-1dd9-4f12-a2e4-1cc7d4023226/9ad1e2a0-5df3-4c05-8e5e-7a1f2fe7c2f1"
```
